fields.v: Evaluates; secondary: Proposes an approach — repository-mining study of 3,387 instruction files in 1,000 AIDev GitHub repositories (adoption, cross-format consistency, maintenance), from which an evidence-based 16-category template for agent instruction files (10 Required, 4 Gap, 2 Recommended) with a maintenance protocol is derived; also introduces the AGIT-Instruct benchmark for instruction-file generation; exploratory generation experiment (with vs without template; four template-guided configurations)

fields.v: Instruction-file generation on AGIT-Instruct eval set (62 files), no coding agent; criterion: coverage of template categories and alignment with developer-written references. - GPT-4o-mini without template (exploratory): coverage 0.187 (Required 0.168, Gap 0.080, Recommended 0.500). - GPT-4o-mini zero-shot with template: coverage 0.828; full-file ROUGE-1 0.423, cos 0.681; overlap-only 0.386 / 0.710. - GPT-4o-mini RAG with template: coverage 0.786; ROUGE-1 0.459, cos 0.683; overlap 0.433 / 0.708; manual 278 instances: 19.4% match, 61.2% partial, 19.4% missing, 0 wrong. - CodeLlama-13B Base with template: coverage 0.645; ROUGE-1 0.304, cos 0.373; overlap 0.309 / 0.434. - CodeLlama-13B QLoRA with template: coverage 0.166 (Gap 0.044); ROUGE-1 0.273, cos 0.608; overlap 0.347 / 0.647. Quality verdict for all: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict for all: not reported

fields.v: Template raises coverage from 18.7% to 82.8% (3.00 to 13.25 categories per file), Gap tier 8.0% to 97.7%. Zero-shot highest coverage (0.828) > RAG 0.786 > CL Base 0.645 > CL QLoRA 0.166; RAG highest full-file ROUGE-1 (0.459 vs 0.423); QLoRA raises cosine 0.373 -> 0.608 but lowers coverage. No significance tests for generation results. Mining: adoption 66.2% top vs 50.2% bottom (OR 1.171 per log stars); multi-format 42.2% vs 21.6%; 16.1% of 386 pairs divergent, none contradictory; 40.4% single-touch files; churn differs by format (H = 31.02, p < 0.001)
